target_definition: At least one associated GOES M1.0+ flare within (t, t+24h].

design_rationale.l2_only: L2 regularization preserves the full frozen 25-feature representation. L1/ElasticNet are excluded because they perform embedded feature selection, which is outside the primary feature contract.
design_rationale.class_weight_candidates: Both unweighted and balanced training are pre-registered because the positive class is rare. Selection will occur only on Cycle24 validation data in Chapter 6.
design_rationale.standardization: The frozen TRAIN-fitted StandardScaler is used because the 25 physical features span very different numerical scales.

selection_protocol.threshold_selection: For each candidate, choose the decision threshold that maximizes TSS on Cycle24 VALIDATION only.
selection_protocol.hyperparameter_selection: Choose the pre-registered Logistic Regression candidate with the highest validation TSS after candidate-specific validation threshold selection.

future_holdout_rule: Cycle24 HOLDOUT remains untouched until model development and threshold selection are complete and the complete Cycle24 pipeline is frozen.
future_cycle25_rule: Cycle25 remains untouched for model development. The frozen pipeline will later be transferred unchanged to Cycle25.
